description: getMerchant(id) becomes getMerchant(tenantId, id) for multi-tenancy. The diff updates two callers; two untouched callers elsewhere still pass (id), so id is read as tenantId and the lookup silently returns null.

expect.lesson: When a function gains, loses or reorders a parameter, check every call site in files the diff does not touch for the old arity or order; a shifted argument is a silent wrong value, not a crash.
